verdict.rationale: Typesense's docs cover running tests in isolated throwaway instances with Testcontainers and GitHub Actions. The engine can be run locally via Docker, Homebrew, or binaries. Through the Cloud MCP server, an agent can create separate dedicated clusters. Together these give a workable path to testing away from production data, but only by standing up separate instances, not through a first-party sandbox or test mode. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/test-mode environment, documented production-data cloning or seeding for test clusters, in-depth guidance beyond section headings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
